checklist.summary: {n} things worth raising for this location, from the checks above, plus three that apply everywhere.
checklist.summaryNone: Nothing in our checks needs raising here. Three steps still apply to every purchase.
checklist.note: Generated from open data for this location. It does not replace advice from your conveyancer or surveyor.

ask.flood: Ask the seller whether the home has flooded or had a flood insurance claim, and get a buildings insurance quote before you exchange. Check if Flood Re applies.
ask.surface: Ask about drainage and any past water coming into the home. Surface water risk is not shown on the river flood map.
ask.floodHistoric: This location sits inside a mapped past flood. Ask the seller for the flood history and any repairs or resilience work.
ask.radon: Ask whether a radon test has been done. If not, a 3-month home test costs about £50 and fixes are usually affordable.
ask.coal: Ask your conveyancer for a CON29M coal mining search, and check that your lender is content with the result.
ask.subsidence: Ask your surveyor to look for cracks and nearby large trees, and ask the seller about past subsidence claims. Consider a Level 3 survey.
ask.ground: Ask your surveyor whether the ground hazards listed above affect the building. Your conveyancer can order a ground stability report.
ask.landfill: Ask your conveyancer for an environmental (contaminated land) search covering past landfill and pollution.
ask.coast: Read the local Shoreline Management Plan and check whether lenders and insurers will cover a property in this erosion zone.
ask.planning: Part of this area is a conservation area or has an Article 4 direction. Check which alterations need planning permission before you plan works.
ask.listed: There are listed buildings here. If the home is listed, any alteration needs listed building consent.
ask.leasehold: Residential Property Tribunal cases exist here. For a leasehold flat, ask for service charge accounts and details of any disputes.

always.searches: Order local authority, water and drainage, and environmental searches through your conveyancer.
always.survey: Commission a survey suited to the age and type of the home.
always.insurance: Get a buildings insurance quote for the exact address before exchange.
